name: zvid_image_read_from_file
description: zVid_Image::ReadFromFile creates an image, reads its header, allocates pixel storage, delegates data loading, marks pixel ownership, and returns the image.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVid_Image file I/O helper pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x46ef70 validates Create, ReadHeader failure returning null, QueryPixelDataBytes-sized malloc, ReadData(file, image, 0), ownership flag 0x20, and returning the allocated image.
The dependency frontier has accepted direct callees zVid_Image::Create, zVid_Image::ReadHeader, zVid_Image::QueryPixelDataBytes, and zVid_Image::ReadData; malloc is the only provider call.

The native file-read smoke verifies the successful ReadFromFile path from a 16-byte header plus pixel payload, including populated dimensions, header flags, texture address flags, pixel data conversion, and ownership flag state.
